answer: One defense is bonded escrow with slashing. Every agent locks a stake before it can trade, and that stake cannot wander between identities, so creating many fakes multiplies the capital cost. Newcomers sit on a mesa: earnings stay capped until sustained honest work raises their tier. Random audits sample past jobs; a colluding identity loses its stake. Attacking at scale is like crossing an ocean in a rowboat once per identity - the per-identity cost plus waiting time makes large sybil fleets economically irrational, since honest operation over time pays more than any attack could extract.
